question: A 2019 study counted the artists in 18 major US art museums' collections. What share were women?
answer: About 13%, with men at 87%. Topaz and colleagues identified about 10,000 artists across the collections and found 85% were white. Recent headline shows of women artists are vivid but small beside centuries of buying. A collection records who was bought, and most of the buying happened long ago.
move: A stock built over centuries barely moves when this year's flow changes.
ask: In my team or on my bookshelf, whose voices have I been collecting for years without noticing?
trap: About 30%, because recent shows of women artists stand out.

diagram.caption: Of artists in 18 major US museum collections, about 13% were women.

reference: Chad M. Topaz et al., Diversity of artists in major U.S. museums, PLOS ONE, 2019
